title: Machtir
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 53b they ask Rabbi Ilai, “Tell us where Rabbi Abbahu is hidden.” He answers, “He took counsel with the Machtir.” Rashi explains that this means the Nasi; Rabbeinu Chananel explains it as taking counsel with the head of the yeshiva. Hyman accordingly takes it to mean Rabbi Yochanan, his teacher, as also reported in Yuchasin in the name of Rav Tzemach Gaon.

notes.text: Machtir is interpreted as the Nasi by Rashi and as the head of the yeshiva by Rabbeinu Chananel. Hyman consequently proposes Yochanan, not a separately established person named Machtir.
